purpose: Evidence and explicit v1.0.0 decision record for localization profiles; acceptance authorizes promotion only in the future atomic stable release commit.

profiles.knownApproximation: Russian ми/ни normally palatalize the preceding consonant; this is a documented localization approximation of canonical MI/NI rather than a change to canonical identity.
decisionEvidence: All seven required readiness checks are true.
The independent Russian practical-transcription and orthographic references support the recorded month syllable map.
The MI/NI palatalization tradeoff is explicitly documented rather than hidden.
Acceptance covers the reviewed month aliases only; RC2 weekday aliases remain a separate unreviewed surface.

profiles.knownApproximation: Official Korean foreign-word rules represent source /z/ before a vowel with ㅈ, so canonical ZU /zu/ is displayed as 주 without redefining canonical /z/.
